transaction_semantics.enqueue_accept: in_valid_i && in_ready_o at a rising edge
transaction_semantics.dequeue_accept: out_valid_o && out_ready_i at a rising edge
transaction_semantics.simultaneous_enqueue_dequeue: When nonempty, remove the old head and append the accepted input; occupancy is unchanged. At full, in_ready_o may depend on an accepted dequeue so throughput remains one word per cycle.
transaction_semantics.ordering: Accepted words are emitted exactly once in FIFO acceptance order
transaction_semantics.stalled_output: While out_valid_o && !out_ready_i, out_valid_o and out_data_o remain stable

state_semantics.empty: empty_o is true exactly when fill_level_o is zero
state_semantics.full: full_o is true exactly when fill_level_o equals DEPTH
state_semantics.fill_level: Exact accepted-enqueue minus accepted-dequeue occupancy in the range 0 through DEPTH
state_semantics.non_power_of_two_depth: All legal depths, including 3, 5, and 7, must wrap without inaccessible or extra entries
state_semantics.invalid_output_data: out_data_o is unspecified when out_valid_o is zero

latency_semantics.empty_enqueue_visibility: A word accepted into an empty FIFO becomes valid only after the accepting edge
